title: Pure S-Force
summary: S-Force cards with generic staples. The page's optional Fiendsmith extension and its Bystial, Chaos and Spright synergies are left out. Each S-Force monster puts a lock on the opponent's monsters in its column, and most of them banish an S-Force card from your hand as a cost, which Retroactive, Chase and World Sorting pay for instead. Rappa Chiyomaru bounces itself to pull another S-Force from the Deck, and Gravitino searches. The Chaos Origins cards lead: Signify searches a monster and draws, Origin revives one from anywhere, World Sorting banishes a card whenever another is banished, and Nightcatcher and Mystify are new Links.
main: S-Force Rappa Chiyomaru
Quick Effect: banishes an S-Force from your hand to bounce itself and summon another from the Deck.
S-Force Gravitino
Summoned: searches an S-Force card; their monsters in its column are banished when they leave.
S-Force Signify
Newest support. Summoned: searches an S-Force monster and draws if they have a monster in its column.
S-Force Pla-Tina
Summoned: returns a banished S-Force; shrinks their monsters in its column.
S-Force Edge Razor
Summoned: summons an S-Force from the hand.
S-Force Lapcewell
Revives an S-Force, and banishes an S-Force card to destroy their monsters in your columns.
S-Force Orrafist
Banishes an S-Force card to destroy an activating monster.
S-Force Dog Tag
Summons itself when they summon; stops monster effects in your columns.
S-Force Retroactive
Link material from the hand; pays an S-Force's banish cost from the GY.
S-Force Bridgehead
Field Spell: searches an S-Force monster.
S-Force Origin
Newest support. Summons an S-Force from the hand, GY or banishment; from the GY, banishes one and mills another.
S-Force Showdown
Quick-Play: summons an S-Force from the hand or recovers one.
S-Force World Sorting
Newest support. Pays banish costs from the Deck; banishes a card whenever another is banished.
S-Force Chase
Bounces a card per differently named S-Force; pays a banish cost from the GY.
S-Force Specimen
Returns an S-Force across from an opposing monster.
extra: Newest support. Link-2: searches an S-Force Spell/Trap and swaps itself for an S-Force from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Newest support. Link-3: moves a monster and stops their activated Special Summons.
Link-3: negates a monster and drags it into the zone it points to.
Link-1: shuffles an S-Force back to return a banished one.
